Maria Park: quick design question — during the playtest I noticed users are confused about the function/schema editor in the Playground. they don't know which fields are required vs optional and the run history doesn't show which schema produced the output :grimacing:
Devin Cho: yeah saw that too. Proposal: add small badges (required/optional) next to param names + a preview pane that shows a sample output for the current schema. also make the history rows show the schema version id and a tiny "re-run" icon
Sam K: accessibility note — badges need text labels (not just color). ensure keyboard focus lands on the run icon and that previews are readable with high contrast. also use aria-live for schema validation errors so screen readers catch them
Aisha Khan: copy tweaks suggestion: replace "Parameters" with "Arguments (inputs)" to be less ambiguous, and change the run-history timestamp to relative (e.g., "3m ago") with tooltip of exact time. For the re-run icon, label it "Re-run with this schema"
Maria Park: nice. UX question: where do we put inline examples? top of the editor (like a sample payload) or collapsed in the preview? I lean collapsed preview to avoid clutter
Devin Cho: collapsed by default, with a one-line placeholder "View sample output" that expands inline. add a small chevron and add keyboard shortcut `r` to re-run the last entry when focus is in the editor
Sam K: please don't rely solely on `r` for discoverability. also ensure the editor supports tab/shift-tab through params and we show a visible focus ring. For contrast, use #0B64A0 on badges instead of the pale blue we used in mockups
Aisha Khan: another copy point — in schema validation errors show a human line: "Missing required field: user_id" rather than raw json-pointer. Have a small "Why this matters" tooltip that explains how missing fields affect tool-calls
Maria Park: technical/dev question for infra: can the run-history store the exact schema snapshot id? we need that to guarantee reproducibility
ui-bot: deploybot: New playground quickfix pushed to staging at 2026-09-02T14:31:05Z :rocket:
Devin Cho: yes, we can store a sha for the schema. implementation note: for compactness show first 7 chars in history row, full sha in hover
Sam K: tiny nit — ensure the chevrons have 44x44 tap targets on mobile and don't rely on hover-only interactions
Aisha Khan: accessibility test plan: keyboard-only replay flows, screen-reader walkthrough of validation error states, and contrast checks for badges + focus ring. I'll add a checklist in the PR
Maria Park: Awesome. I'll update the mocks with the collapsed sample output, required/optional badges with labels, and the new copy. I'll also add the re-run icon and schema-sha in history. tagging @Devin Cho to follow up on implementation and @Aisha Khan for accessibility sign-off :eyes:
Devin Cho: I'll spin a quick prototype branch with the schema-sha in history + re-run shortcut. will link a demo later
Aisha Khan: I'll pre-approve the accessibility checklist once the prototype is up. +1 on inline human-friendly validation messages :thumbsup:
Maria Park: thanks all. quick todos: (1) Maria update mocks, (2) Devin prototype branch, (3) Aisha accessibility checklist, (4) Sam run mobile/touch checks. ping here when PR is up. :sparkles:
